$comment: knownGaps is a ratchet, not a mute button: a listed gap does not fail the build, an
unlisted one does, and a listed gap that has since been closed ALSO fails — so the
list can only ever shrink. The count is the debt number this project reports.
Each remaining entry is a component that ships in code but cannot yet be placed on a
Figma canvas. Closing one means building a component set whose variant properties
match the prop unions in the code, then deleting its line here.
$nonPropProperties: Figma properties that legitimately have no React prop. state is a variant axis because
Hover and Disabled change fills, and Figma cannot express a fill change as a boolean —
but in code they are a CSS pseudo-class and a native attribute. content is placeholder
vs value, which in code is simply whether the field has text in it. This is the two
media disagreeing about mechanism, not the system drifting.
$nonVariantProps: Code props that are deliberately not design-time variants. Modelling
DropdownMenu side x align would be twelve variants of the same menu, documenting Radix
collision handling rather than a design decision.
